ModMetaData.description:
SW content for the promise/whisper structure program (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/structure_injection_roster.md), riding mandrake.rm.injections' GenStep_RimplacePlan engine.
Ships one promise so far: The Moisture Farm (roster row 1) - a vaporator ring around a buried cistern hut, walled yard. The rimplace template is authored and lints/verifies clean; the TileMutatorDef/GenStepDef wiring exists and proves the engine end to end. It is NOT yet placed on any Ash'karr tile (a live world-tile edit, deliberately deferred - see structure_injection_roster.md) and has no letter text in the god's register yet. 43 more roster rows remain open for future batches.
